seo.title: German A1 Course in Dehradun | Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1 | Language Zone
seo.description: German A1 (Beginner) course in Dehradun. Introduce yourself and handle everyday phrases. Online and offline batches at Language Zone.

outcomes: Introduce yourself and others, and say where you live and what you do
Ask and answer simple questions about daily life
Understand and use greetings, numbers, dates and times
Order food and ask for prices
Fill in a simple form and write a short message
suits: Complete beginners with no German at all
Applicants whose visa or family reunion papers ask for A1
Students starting a long path towards study or work in Germany
syllabus: Articles der, die, das and plurals

skills.listening: Slow, clear announcements and short dialogues
skills.writing: Fill in forms and write short messages
skills.speaking: Introduce yourself, ask and answer simple questions

faq.q: Do I need any German before joining A1?
faq.a: No. This course assumes no previous knowledge. We begin with the alphabet and pronunciation.

faq.q: What does the A1 exam test?
faq.a: Reading, listening, writing and speaking, all at a basic level. We practise each part in class and in mock tests.

faq.q: When can I move on to A2?
faq.a: Once you are comfortable with A1 tasks and your trainer confirms your level. A counsellor can share the next A2 batch dates.
